content.bridge_context: Following the domestic setting of 'A Gift of Chappals', this story returns to a royal court but with a humorous, comic-strip twist on a classic folktale.

units.title: Comic Strip Storytelling
units.explanation: A comic strip uses pictures and speech bubbles (balloons) to tell a story instead of long paragraphs.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify who is speaking in the speech bubbles. / पहचानें कि स्पीच बबल में कौन बोल रहा है।

units.title: Wit vs. Strength
units.explanation: Gopal uses his brain to win a challenge where no one else could succeed. Wit is the ability to use words and ideas cleverly.
units.dual_language_instruction: Think of other characters known for their wit (like Birbal or Tenali Raman). / अन्य बुद्धिमान पात्रों (जैसे बीरबल या तेनाली रमन) के बारे में सोचें।
